intro.paragraph1: H2Fleet Technologies Inc. ("H2Fleet," "we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our H2Fleet Planner platform and services (the "Service").

intro.controllerProcessor: H2Fleet Technologies Inc. acts as the data controller for the personal data of your users; for telematics data, we act as a data processor on behalf of your organization.

communications.item1: Send transactional emails (account verification, password resets, billing)
communications.item2: Provide service updates and important notices
communications.item3: Send marketing communications (with your consent, which you may withdraw)

legalBases.title: 2.4 Legal Bases for Processing (GDPR)
legalBases.content: For users in the EEA, we process personal data based on: (a) contract performance, (b) legitimate interests, (c) consent, or (d) legal obligations.

storage.title: 3.1 Data Storage
storage.content: Your data is stored using a secure cloud database platform. Our primary data centers are located in North America. Data may be transferred to and processed in jurisdictions outside your home country, subject to appropriate safeguards.

measures.title: 3.2 Security Measures
measures.intro: We implement industry-standard security measures including:
measures.item1: Encryption of data in transit (TLS/SSL) and at rest
measures.item2: Secure authentication with password hashing and optional multi-factor authentication
measures.item3: Regular security assessments and vulnerability testing
measures.item5: Automated backups and disaster recovery procedures

breach.title: 3.3 Data Breach Notification
breach.content: In the event of a data breach that affects your personal information, we will notify you and relevant authorities as required by applicable law, typically within 72 hours of becoming aware of the breach.

access.title: 4.1 Access and Portability
access.content: You have the right to request a copy of the personal information we hold about you. You may export your project data and reports at any time through the Service interface.

correction.title: 4.2 Correction
correction.content: You may update or correct your personal information through your account settings or by contacting us.

deletion.title: 4.3 Deletion
deletion.content: You may request deletion of your account and personal data by contacting us at contact@h2fleet.ca. We will process your request within 30 days, subject to any legal retention requirements.

restriction.title: 4.4 Restriction and Objection
restriction.content: You may request restriction of processing or object to certain processing activities. You may also withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time.

complaints.title: 4.5 Complaints
complaints.content: If you believe we have violated your privacy rights, you may file a complaint with us or with the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada (for Canadian residents) or your local data protection authority (for EEA residents).

essential.label: Essential Cookies
essential.value: Required for the Service to function (authentication, security)

analytics.label: Analytics Cookies
analytics.value: Help us understand how users interact with the Service

managing.title: 5.2 Managing Cookies
managing.content: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling essential cookies may affect the functionality of the Service. We do not use cookies for advertising purposes.

payment.title: 6.1 Payment Processing
payment.content: We use Stripe to process payments. When you make a payment, your payment card information is collected and processed directly by Stripe in accordance with their privacy policy. We do not store complete payment card numbers on our servers.

infrastructure.title: 6.2 Infrastructure Providers
infrastructure.content: We use cloud infrastructure providers (including associated hosting services) to store and process your data. These providers maintain their own security and privacy practices.

analytics.title: 6.3 Analytics
analytics.content: We may use analytics services to understand Service usage. These services collect aggregated, anonymized data.

active.title: 7.1 Active Accounts
active.content: We retain your personal information and project data for as long as your account is active and you maintain a subscription to the Service.

closure.title: 7.2 After Account Closure
closure.content: After you close your account, we retain certain information for up to 90 days to allow for data export requests. After this period, your data will be permanently deleted, except as required for legal, accounting, or compliance purposes.

aggregated.title: 7.3 Aggregated Data
aggregated.content: We may retain anonymized, aggregated data indefinitely for analytics and research purposes. This data cannot be used to identify you.

children.title: 8. Children's Privacy
children.content: The Service is intended for business use and is not directed to individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we learn that we have collected information from a child, we will delete it promptly.

changes.title: 9. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes by posting the updated policy on our website and updating the "Last Updated" date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

opex.insurance: Insurance: annual premium based on vehicle value
opex.downtime: Downtime: estimated productivity loss during charging/refueling

maintenance.dieselDesc: Higher due to complex drivetrain, oil changes, exhaust system maintenance
maintenance.evDesc: Lower costs: fewer moving parts, regenerative braking reduces brake wear
maintenance.h2Desc: Fuel cell stack maintenance, hydrogen system inspections

consumption.note: Note: Consumption rates vary based on vehicle class, load, terrain, and temperature. Adaptive multipliers are applied for operational conditions.

infrastructure.evFormula: Chargers = ceil(EVs × Battery Capacity / (Charging Speed × Hours Available × Utilization))
infrastructure.evDefaults: Default: 150 kWh battery, 50 kW chargers, 8h availability, 80% utilization
infrastructure.h2Formula: Stations = ceil(Daily H₂ Demand / Station Capacity)

residual.formula: Residual Value = Purchase Price × Depreciation Factor

faq.q1: Why is the default discount rate 5%?
faq.a1: A 5% discount rate represents a typical cost of capital for fleet operators. You can adjust this in Advanced Parameters to match your specific financing costs.
faq.q2: How are cold weather impacts calculated?
faq.a2: Cold weather can reduce EV range by 20-40%. When enabled, this multiplier is applied to energy consumption based on regional climate data.
faq.a3: TOU pricing applies different electricity rates based on charging time. Off-peak charging (nights/weekends) can reduce costs by 30-50%.
faq.a4: Carbon credits are based on CO₂ savings vs diesel baseline, valued at the current carbon price (typically $65-170/tonne in Canada).

featureDoc.title: Platform Feature Documentation
featureDoc.subtitle: Comprehensive guide to H2Fleet Planner modules
featureDoc.downloadSuccessDescription: The PDF has been saved to your downloads folder.
featureDoc.downloadErrorDescription: An error occurred while generating the PDF.
featureDoc.challengeText: The transition to zero-emission heavy-duty fleets is complex: fluctuating energy costs, evolving regulations, diverse technology options, and significant infrastructure investments. Fleet managers need reliable tools to make informed decisions based on solid financial and operational data.
featureDoc.solutionText: H2Fleet Planner is a B2B SaaS platform that enables fleet managers to simulate diesel-to-EV/H2 transitions, compare scenarios using Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis, and plan phased deployment roadmaps over 10-15 year horizons. Our platform combines regional reference data, infrastructure planning tools, and subsidies databases to provide comprehensive decision support.
audienceList: Fleet managers in transportation and logistics
valueList: Data-driven decision making with TCO, CAPEX/OPEX analysis
Access to subsidies database and supplier directory
Phased deployment planning with Gantt roadmap

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: The Dashboard serves as your central command center, providing a real-time overview of your fleet transition progress. It displays key performance indicators, project summaries, and quick access to all major platform features. The dashboard is designed to give fleet managers an immediate understanding of their zero-emission transition status.
features: Real-time fleet composition overview with vehicle counts by fuel type
TCO summary cards showing total cost of ownership across all scenarios
Recent projects list with quick navigation
Data quality indicators and reference data status
One-click CSV export for fleet data
useCases: Morning check on fleet transition progress
Executive reporting and status updates
Quick navigation to active projects
dashboard.screenshotCaption: Figure 1: Dashboard overview showing KPIs and recent projects

scenarios.title: TCO Scenarios
scenarios.description: The Scenarios module is the core analytical engine of H2Fleet Planner. It enables you to create, compare, and analyze multiple fleet transition scenarios including diesel baseline, battery-electric (BEV), hydrogen fuel cell (FCEV), and mixed fleet configurations. Each scenario calculates comprehensive Total Cost of Ownership over your chosen analysis horizon.
features: Multi-scenario comparison with side-by-side TCO analysis
Flexible fleet composition with multiple vehicle categories
Configurable analysis horizon (5-20 years) and discount rates
CO2 emissions calculation and reduction tracking
PDF export of detailed scenario results
useCases: Comparing BEV vs FCEV for long-haul trucking
Building a business case for fleet electrification
Sensitivity analysis on fuel price variations
scenarios.screenshotCaption: Figure 2: Scenario creation form with fleet composition

analytics.title: Advanced Analytics
analytics.description: The Analytics module provides deep insights into your fleet transition data through interactive visualizations, What-If analyses, and ESG tracking. It enables data-driven decision making by allowing you to explore different parameters and understand their impact on TCO and emissions.
features: What-If analysis with real-time parameter adjustments
Sensitivity analysis charts for key cost drivers
ESG objectives tracker with target setting
Cost projections and investment breakdown charts
ROI calculations and payback period analysis
useCases: Understanding impact of electricity price changes on BEV TCO
Tracking progress toward corporate sustainability goals
Presenting investment analysis to stakeholders
analytics.screenshotCaption: Figure 3: Analytics dashboard with What-If analysis

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure Planning
infrastructure.description: The Infrastructure module helps you plan and size the charging and refueling infrastructure needed for your zero-emission fleet. It calculates station requirements based on fleet size, daily energy demand, and operational patterns, while providing cost estimates and feasibility alerts.
features: Automatic charging station sizing based on fleet needs
Grid capacity analysis and upgrade requirements
Interactive infrastructure map with depot locations
Feasibility alerts for power grid constraints
useCases: Planning charging infrastructure for a new BEV fleet
Evaluating hydrogen station investment for regional operations
Identifying grid upgrade requirements before fleet deployment
infrastructure.screenshotCaption: Figure 4: Infrastructure planning with station requirements

roadmap.title: Roadmap Builder
roadmap.description: The Roadmap Builder enables you to create detailed deployment timelines for your fleet transition. It breaks down your transition into phases and milestones, helping you visualize the implementation schedule, track progress, and manage dependencies between different workstreams.
features: Gantt chart visualization of transition phases
Milestone tracking with due dates and assignments
useCases: Planning a 5-year fleet electrification roadmap
Coordinating vehicle procurement with infrastructure deployment
Tracking progress against regulatory compliance deadlines
roadmap.screenshotCaption: Figure 5: Roadmap builder with Gantt chart view

telematics.title: Telematics Integration
telematics.description: The Telematics module enables you to import real operational data from your fleet management systems. By analyzing actual vehicle usage patterns, daily mileage, and fuel consumption, the platform can generate more accurate scenarios and recommendations tailored to your specific operations.
features: Import fleet data via CSV or API integration
Vehicle grouping based on operational patterns
Automatic technology recommendations per vehicle group
Auto-generated scenarios based on real data
Fleet analytics dashboard with usage insights
useCases: Importing Geotab data to identify electrification candidates
Analyzing daily mileage to determine range requirements
Creating data-driven scenarios from actual fleet operations
telematics.screenshotCaption: Figure 6: Telematics import and vehicle grouping

referenceData.title: Reference Data
referenceData.description: The Reference Data module provides access to curated market data including vehicle prices, energy costs, emission factors, and more. All data is region-specific and regularly updated. Users can view, filter, and in some cases customize these values to match their specific context.
features: Vehicle specifications and pricing by category
CO2 emission factors by energy source
Data freshness indicators and source citations
Custom data creation for proprietary information
useCases: Checking current hydrogen prices in your region
Customizing vehicle prices based on negotiated quotes
Reviewing emission factors for carbon credit calculations
referenceData.screenshotCaption: Figure 7: Reference data table with energy prices

suppliers.title: Suppliers Directory
suppliers.description: The Suppliers Directory is a curated database of vehicle manufacturers, infrastructure providers, fuel suppliers, and service providers in the zero-emission transportation ecosystem. It helps fleet managers identify and connect with potential partners for their transition projects.
features: Supplier profiles with products and services
Filter by supplier type, region, and certifications
useCases: Finding hydrogen fuel cell truck manufacturers
Identifying charging infrastructure installers in your region
Building a shortlist of potential partners for RFP
suppliers.screenshotCaption: Figure 8: Suppliers directory with map view

subsidies.title: Subsidies & Funding
subsidies.description: The Subsidies module provides a comprehensive database of government incentives, grants, and funding programs available for zero-emission fleet transition. It includes federal, provincial, and municipal programs with eligibility criteria, application deadlines, and direct links to program portals.
features: Federal and provincial incentive programs database
Eligibility calculator based on fleet and vehicle type
useCases: Finding available incentives for Class 8 electric trucks
Planning applications around upcoming program deadlines
Calculating total incentive value for a fleet purchase
